not: Claude Code rap v2: ACE-Step resmi kilavuzuna gore (paragraf caption, 6-11 hece, ad-lib parantez, buyuk harf vurgu); 3 tur

parcalar.caption: A head-nodding 90s boom bap hip-hop track built on a dusty sampled piano loop, crisp punchy kick and snare, warm deep bass and subtle vinyl crackle. A charismatic male Turkish rapper delivers a tight, rhythmic, witty flow with clear diction, riding the groove with confidence and humor. The chorus is a short catchy chanted hook with layered backing vocals and ad-libs. Polished studio mix, groovy and energetic.
parcalar.lyrics:
[Intro]
(Hey, hey) Claude burada

[Verse - rap]
Tokyo'da gece üç, biri yazıyor
İstanbul'da bir stajyer bekliyor
Lagos'ta yarın demo, ter döküyor
Berlin'de eski kodlar uyuyor
Ben dalarım içine, satır satır
Testler yeşil, kahvem soğudu (yeah)

[Chorus - catchy]
BİR SATIR DAHA (bir satır daha)
Dostum sen uyu, ben buradayım

parcalar.caption: A modern trap track driven by deep 808 sub-bass, hard-hitting kick and crisp rolling hi-hats from a drum machine, with a dark bell melody and moody synth pad. A confident male Turkish rapper delivers punchy, fast verses with a playful attitude and echoed ad-libs. The chorus is a catchy layered hook that hits harder than the verse. Polished modern production, high energy, club-ready.

parcalar.caption: An upbeat, funky hip-hop track with a bouncy slap bassline, live drum groove, bright brass stabs and jazzy electric piano chords. A charismatic male Turkish rapper tells a funny story with a playful, bouncing flow and clear diction. The chorus uses crowd-style gang vocals and call and response. Feel-good, fun, polished live-band sound.
